alt: September 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a woman in a white and gold sari making a large flower rangoli of marigolds and purple petals. Onam and Id-e-Milad are marked.
caption: A calendar page for September 2025 features a detailed illustration of a woman creating a flower mandala.
description: The artwork shows a woman in a white sari seated beside a large, colorful mandala made of marigolds and jasmine. She holds a single flower while a bowl of additional blooms rests nearby. The calendar grid at the bottom dates the month, marking September 5th as Onam and 6th as Milad.
